objects.name: Analytic 2237
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a field device or serial gateway receiving Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol traffic relayed through an intermediate host, identifiable by protocol-level timing anomalies or L2 source address changes where the device Internet Protocol (IP) address responds from a Media Access Control (MAC) address different from its enrolled hardware address. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: protocol-level latency inconsistent with direct communication, or Media Access Control (MAC)/Internet Protocol (IP) address binding change for device_ip
